_note: Prices here are what the site charges. The checkout reads them server side, so this file is the single source of truth. Reconciled product by product against her Gator admin on 2026-08-26.
_fulfilment: download = signed link, instantly. booking = she sends a calendar link. email-file = she emails the file herself. send-draft = the customer emails their document in. A product may set 'file' with ANY of these: a booking still hands over its instructions sheet.
_hidden: visible:false keeps a product out of the store grid but leaves it working, matching what Gator has hidden today.

products.name: Testing Accommodations: Workbook + Examples
products.description: Walk away with a complete accommodations request you can adapt to your own diagnosis. Inside: her full example application for USMLE Step 1, 2 and 3, a template for your personal statement, a template to hand your health professional for the supporting letter, the most requested DSM-5 criteria for ADHD, MDD, GAD, panic and PTSD, and workbook pages on how to disclose in applications and at school. Bonus: an anonymous personal statement from a medical student with ADHD, MDD and GAD. The file is too large to download here, so Dr. Moss emails it to you within 12 to 24 hours.

products.name: Advising with Dr. Moss, 1 hr
products.description: Leave with a plan for your own situation, not general advice. One hour on failed exams, accommodations, a possible dismissal, a leave of absence, gap years, career pivots in or out of medicine, or applying with red flags or as an IMG.

products.name: Mock Interview with Dr. Moss
products.description: Practise the interview before it counts. A 30 minute mock plus 30 minutes of feedback, one to one, with the option to have it recorded so you can watch yourself back. You get constructive feedback on your answers, body language, virtual background and overall presentation, and practice on the hard questions: academic failures, health conditions and disabilities, red flags, gap years and leaves of absence.

products.name: Residency Mock Interview Course + Workbook
products.description: Ten or more recorded mock interviews using real questions previous applicants were asked, with a pause built in so you answer inside the time limit before you hear what worked. Internal medicine, family medicine, psychiatry, paediatrics and surgery, with and without an IMG focus. The workbook gives you practice prompts and space to draft your answers, plus guidance on delivery, professionalism, your virtual setup and the questions worth asking them. Buy once and every recording added later is yours.

products.name: Application or Personal Statement Editing
products.description: Get your application read by someone who received over 24 interviews dual-applying to psychiatry and family medicine. One pass across all 10 activities, your 3 most meaningful, publications and impactful experience, with a full analysis of content, voice and tone, custom feedback and proofreading. Personal statements for medical school, residency, fellowship or an accommodations application. Turnaround is 48 to 72 hours.

products.name: Advising with Dr. Moss, 30 min
products.description: A focused half hour on one question. Good for a single decision: whether to disclose, how to explain a gap, which programs to signal, or what to do next after a failed exam. Dr. Moss emails you her calendar once you have booked.

products.name: Residency Application Workbook
products.description: Forty-six worksheet pages that take you through the 2025-26 ERAS cycle one decision at a time: finding people to write your letters, building a personal statement that sounds like you, working out which activities are genuinely meaningful, deciding what matters to you in a program, and how to balance applying to several. Written after she dual-applied to psychiatry and family medicine, took over 24 interviews and matched her first choice. Updates come by email.

products.name: Full ERAS & PS Residency Application
products.description: Her actual 2023-24 ERAS application, in full: all 10 activities, the 3 most meaningful, publications, impactful experiences, geographic preference and both personal statements. This is the application that brought in over 24 interview invitations and matched her into her top choice programme in psychiatry. Read what a real one looks like before you write your own.

products.name: 2026 ERAS & PS for Fellowship
products.description: Her full 2026 application to psychiatry fellowship: all 10 activities with the 3 most meaningful, the updated 2026 publications section, impactful experiences, geographic preference and two personal statements. Fellowship applicants have almost nothing real to look at, and this is a complete one, written after three years of helping other people tell their own story.

products.name: Medical School Application Workbook
products.description: Forty-two worksheet pages for the medical school cycle: finding letter writers, building a personal statement, choosing which activities to lead with, working out what you actually want from a school, and a checklist for dual applying MD and DO. Written after she applied to both and was accepted to five. Updates come by email.
